name: Finnrr Lyrics
description: Finnrr's own lyrics plugin. Downloads synced lyrics from lrclib.net with configurable search options, and automatically syncs lyrics for newly added music after each library scan. Fork of Felitendo/jellyfin-plugin-lyrics (GPL-3.0).
overview: Finnrr lyrics plugin with configurable search options, automatic library scanning, and auto-sync for newly added music
